summary: Practise G2P reconciliation, exception investigation, and complaint controls. Explore the course and strengthen your payment operations workflow.
lede: Digital social-protection payment operations helps programme finance and payment teams trace transactions and resolve delivery exceptions. Participants map payment handoffs, reconcile instructions against provider records, investigate failed or duplicate transactions, and connect beneficiary complaints to documented resolution actions using spreadsheet-based records. They also practise maintaining exception logs and recording evidence for case closure.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, reconcile, oversee, or support digital payments in social-protection and humanitarian programmes.
prerequisites: Prior experience with social-protection, cash-transfer, programme finance, registry, or payment operations is helpful. No coding is required. Familiarity with spreadsheets and basic payment records will support the practical exercises.
